name: Shelf Reapers
description: The Shelf Reapers are the most feared fighting stable operating in the BLOODWORK underground circuit, based out of a converted water reclamation facility in the deep Shelf known as the Cistern. Founded by retired Tier 2 chrome-fighter Adaeze Mirković-Sohn after she was blacklisted from sanctioned leagues, the stable trains fighters across every augmentation tier — from bare-chrome brawlers to near-illegal military surplus rigs.
story_hooks: A corponation fixer arrives on the Shelf offering the Reapers legitimization — and a contract that would give the corporation full rights to the fighters' augmentation data.
One of the Reapers' star fighters has been secretly feeding match outcomes to a Tier 4 gambling syndicate, and Mirković-Sohn is starting to notice the pattern.
A runner is hired to extract a minor from the Reapers' training facility — but the minor insists they chose this life and refuses to leave.
